description: Registration is one screen with an optional visit

name: fd-01-same-person
description: A likely existing record is offered while typing

name: fd-02-fee-preview
assert: !document.body.innerText.includes('Is this the same person?') && document.body.innerText.includes('To pay now') && document.body.innerText.includes('General consultation') && [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Register & send to cashier')
description: The fee preview shows the charge and the button names the next stop

name: fd-03-registered-and-booked
assert: (() => { const p = window.designAudit.rows.patients.find(x => x.fullName === 'Synthetic Front Desk Patient'); return window.designAudit.path === '/patients/profile' && Boolean(p) && window.designAudit.rows.appointments.some(a => a.patientId === p.id && a.visitType === 'general') && document.body.innerText.includes('to pay at the cashier'); })()
description: One save registers, books for now and says where the patient goes

name: fd-04-expected
description: Today is split into expected and arrived

name: fd-05-arrived
assert: (() => { const a = window.designAudit.rows.appointments.find(x => x.id === 'appointment:today'); return a.attendance === 'arrived' && JSON.parse(a.activity).map(x => x.action).join(',') === 'arrived' && document.querySelector('#arrived-heading')?.textContent === 'Arrived or in care · 1' && !document.body.innerText.includes('Undo arrival'); })()
description: Arrival is recorded with one tap, attributed in the booking history, and the row moves to Arrived

name: fd-06-rebook
description: A missed booking opens the existing reschedule directly

name: fd-07-in-clinic-today
assert: document.body.innerText.includes('In clinic today') && document.body.innerText.includes('Amaka Okoro') && !document.body.innerText.includes('With a balance')
description: In clinic today lists today's patients; balances stay hidden from a role without billing access

name: fd-08-identity-compare
description: Two records are compared side by side

name: fd-09-phone
description: The one-screen registration fits a 320px phone
